purpose: Mistakes found in published sources by the board's reviewers and red teams.

issues.source: Böckle–Iyengar–Paškūnas (BIP), Zariski density of crystalline points, Forum Math. Pi (arXiv v2 numbering)
issues.locator: Lemma 6.5, pp. 47–48 (proof step at arXiv lines 2714–2715)
issues.says: the printed character ψ fails the step at the uniformizer: for F=ℚ₅ with κ(5) the Teichmüller lift of 2, ψ(5)=1 whereas κ̄(5)=2
issues.should: a corrected choice of ψ compatible with κ̄ at the uniformizer, as the repaired step requires

issues.source: Böckle–Iyengar–Paškūnas (BIP), Zariski density of crystalline points, Forum Math. Pi
issues.locator: the proof of Theorem 6.8, p. 49 (arXiv line 2781)
issues.says: the whole support of a nonzero test module lies in one component, which does not follow, since a support can meet two components (e.g. Spec L[x,y]/(xy))
issues.should: a component chosen through a point of the fixed-ψ fibre, which suffices for the argument

issues.source: Emerton–Paškūnas (EP), density of supercuspidal points of fixed regular weight in local deformation rings, published pp. 337–371
issues.says: the capture statements without excluding W=0; then {0} would capture O[[K]]≠0, false (witness M=O, H={1}, W=0)
issues.should: stated with the hypothesis W≠0

issues.source: Fu (fu24), Annals of Math. 200
issues.says: Theorem 5.1 for weights λ beyond those its argument covers; at p=3, λ=1 the quantity 2λ+1=3 is not a square in ℚ₃
issues.should: restricted to induced weights λ, for which the relevant value is (μ+1)²

issues.source: Fu (fu24), Annals of Math. 200
issues.locator: Theorem 3.2, the PBW growth estimate, pp. 8–11 (argument at arXiv line 537)
issues.says: the estimate across the whole weight strip, but the argument proves it only for k≥α
issues.should: supplemented by an argument covering the remaining weights of the strip

issues.source: Wagner, q-Witt vectors and q-Hodge complexes, arXiv:2410.23078v5
issues.says: the differential–Frobenius relation with V_n where F_n belongs, an ill-typed expression n(d∘V_n)
issues.should: dF_n = nF_n d, which is what the proof of the lemma gives

issues.source: Wagner, q-Witt vectors and q-Hodge complexes, arXiv:2410.23078v5
issues.says: graded commutativity follows coefficientwise on cochains, but a closed form need not be fixed coefficientwise (ω=YdX+XdY gives (γ_X−1)ω=hXdY≠0)
issues.should: a cochain homotopy showing the commutator is a boundary, so the conclusion holds in cohomology

issues.source: Asakura–Miyatani, Milnor K-theory, F-isocrystals and syntomic regulators, arXiv:2007.14255v2
issues.says: the acyclicity lemma for smooth schemes with no affineness assumption, which a proper elliptic curve (H¹(O)=K) refutes
issues.should: stated for affine schemes, as its proof, which starts from an affine embedding, assumes

issues.source: Asakura–Miyatani, Milnor K-theory, F-isocrystals and syntomic regulators, arXiv:2007.14255v2
issues.says: the comparison is an isomorphism of B†_K-algebras
issues.should: an isomorphism of B†_K-modules

issues.source: Asakura–Miyatani, Milnor K-theory, F-isocrystals and syntomic regulators, arXiv:2007.14255v2
issues.says: the evaluation of extensions may identify H⁰ with Q_p, which is unjustified on a disconnected base
issues.should: carried out with the distinguished class 1, without that identification

issues.source: Gan–Gross–Prasad, Symplectic local root numbers, central critical L-values, and restriction problems, arXiv:0909.2999v1
issues.says: the twisted representation is π·μ0⁻¹
issues.should: the twist consistent with the relation ν_{μ′} ≅ μ0·ν_μ stated just before (line 2623)

issues.source: Beuzart-Plessis–Chaudouard–Zydor, The global Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for unitary groups: the endoscopic case, arXiv:2007.05601v1
issues.says: the order of the component group S_Π with an inverted sign in the exponent
issues.should: |S_Π| = 2^(dim a_P), the coefficient being its inverse 2^(−dim a_P)

issues.source: Garvan, New combinatorial interpretations of Ramanujan's partition congruences mod 5, 7 and 11, 1988
issues.says: the residue-five term of the eleven-dissection of V(ζ₁₁;q) is −(c₂+c₄)(A₃B₂−XA₈B₇), giving a nonzero q⁴⁹ coefficient where all crank counts equal 15775
issues.should: −(c₂+c₄)(A₃B₂−XA₉B₇), as in the paper's own (6.24)

issues.source: Zagier, Ramanujan's mock theta functions and their applications, 2009
issues.locator: Theorem 7.1 and its proof (rank-to-Lerch display, cached lines 947–948)
issues.says: a Lerch-sum expression for the rank generating function at a root of unity that fails numerical checks
issues.should: the version with corrected signs and q^(−1/6): −η(3τ)³/(η(τ)ϑ(3α;3τ)) + q^(−1/6)[ξ⁻¹μ̂(3α,−τ) − ξμ̂(3α,τ)]

issues.source: Bruinier–Funke, On two geometric theta lifts, arXiv math/0212286v4
issues.says: the image of the Fourier mode H(2πnv)e(nu) carries a factor −2v^(2−k)
issues.should: the formula without that factor, which is what direct differentiation produces

issues.source: Gasper, Lecture notes for an introductory minicourse on q-series, arXiv math/9509223v1
issues.locator: the convergence radius for |q|>1 (cached lines 775–784 and 846–854)
issues.says: a radius that omits a factor |q|
issues.should: the radius including the factor |q| that the notes' own (1.3.11) carries

issues.source: Dolgachev–Keum, Finite groups of symplectic automorphisms of K3 surfaces in positive characteristic, arXiv math/0403478v5
issues.says: an automorphism of order at most 2 of a free ℤ_ℓ-module acts trivially mod 2, false (the swap matrix on ℤ₂²)
issues.should: an argument that tracks the integral extension terms, since (4.9) alone gives no bound on ρ(X)

issues.source: Dolgachev–Keum, Finite groups of symplectic automorphisms of K3 surfaces in positive characteristic, arXiv math/0403478v5
issues.locator: the proof of Theorem 3.3, p. 13 (cached lines 511–520)
issues.says: only orders 11 and 15 survive as extra rank-20 candidates, but n=14 with (a₂,a₇,a₁₄)=(1,1,1) satisfies every relation
issues.should: a list that includes 14, excluded like the others (root lattice A₁₃⊕A₆⊕A₁, square discriminant 196)

issues.source: Nikulin, Finite automorphism groups of Kähler K3 surfaces
issues.locator: §5, equation (5.2) and its case list, pp. 108–110 of the Russian original
issues.says: the solutions of t_pq(p+1)(q+1)=24 without (p,q)=(2,7), t=1, that is order 14
issues.should: a list including that solution, which is then disposed of separately

issues.source: Huybrechts, Lectures on K3 surfaces (author draft)
issues.says: (via "respectively") discriminant −64 for the infinite-height case p≡3 mod 4 and −p² for the other case
issues.should: the reverse: −p² for infinite height (rank 22, p-elementary), −64 for the other

issues.source: Rizov, Moduli stacks of polarized K3 surfaces in mixed characteristic, arXiv math/0506120v2
issues.locator: §4.3, the frame construction and quotient presentation after Theorem 4.3.3, pp. 20–25
issues.says: a wrong size for the projective linear group in the later presentation
issues.should: PGL_(9d+2), matching the rank 9d+2 of the sections of L³

issues.source: Liu–Tian–Xiao–Zhang–Zhu, On the Beilinson–Bloch–Kato conjecture for Rankin–Selberg motives, arXiv:1912.11942v3
issues.locator: Lemma 5.11.3(2), p. 98 (same claim in the published version)
issues.says: Q††→P†† is a trivial ℙ¹-bundle; at n=2, p=3 over a quartic C it is ℙ(O_C⊕O_C(4)), with a section of self-intersection −16, so not a product
issues.should: the projectivization of the sum of the two link normal lines, only Zariski-locally trivial

issues.source: Liu–Tian–Xiao–Zhang–Zhu, On the Beilinson–Bloch–Kato conjecture for Rankin–Selberg motives, arXiv:1912.11942v3
issues.locator: the printed proof at cached lines 702–707
issues.says: restriction of scalars followed by extension gives identical copies of the adjoint; the summands are Frobenius twists (over 𝔽₄₉, C₄₈-weights 7, 6: k-linear Hom vanishes, the x↦x⁷ twist does not)
issues.should: a decomposition into Frobenius twists, requiring Hom vanishing for every twist of the adjoint

issues.source: Besser, p-adic heights and Vologodsky integration, arXiv:1711.06957v1
issues.says: the displayed Frobenius and monodromy identities with inconsistent subscripts on the pairing
issues.should: one pairing used consistently

issues.source: Besser, p-adic Arakelov theory, arXiv math/0301029v1
issues.says: the principal-divisor reciprocity informally so that it includes f=0
issues.should: restricted to nonzero f
